تجتنون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَنُونَ (tajtanūna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# تُجْتَنَوْنَ (tujtanawna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.naw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
